name: MCL Slow Product Auction to Fast WTI Trigger
hypothesis: Non-overlapping, Globex-session-anchored RB/HO refinery-complex auction epochs may remove five-minute flicker while the first causal aligned CL and MCL five-minute move supplies executable timing.

causal_law.slow_clock: completed non-overlapping blocks anchored to the 18:00 ET Globex session
causal_law.slow_state: both RB and HO outright moves or both 42x product-minus-CL crack-spread moves must agree in sign
causal_law.state_transition: retain the last nonzero slow direction; one new opposite direction arms one pending auction
causal_law.fast_trigger: the first subsequent completed five-minute CL and matched-MCL move aligned with the pending direction triggers exactly once
causal_law.direction_owner: technical product-complex state proposes direction; completed CL trend labels acceptance versus failed-auction reversal; news has no direction authority
causal_law.cold_start: seed the first state per session and contract without an event
causal_law.freshness: both product endpoints must map and the current RB and HO slow-block closes must have positive volume

selection_law: Choose the first profile clearing every count-only gate. Slower refinery-margin state precedes faster state and outright controls. No price outcome may select a profile.
if_eligible: Freeze one exact financing-epoch lifecycle before opening PnL; neighbors remain cadence controls and cannot replace the primary from outcomes.
if_ineligible: Close block-horizon product routing before PnL and design a materially distinct owner; do not sweep overlapping windows, thresholds, clocks, or quotas.
